rule: LEVEL_4, LEVEL_5, LEVEL_6, and LEVEL_UNKNOWN content may be retrieved for context/explanation only (allowed_usage: [context, explanation]). Only LEVEL_1-3 content, and only after explicit review_status=approved, may ever be flagged can_influence_chakra_score or can_influence_raga_recommendation = true for anything touching a diagnosable medical/psychiatric condition. Traditional/energetic (LEVEL_4/5) musicological or time-of-day metadata (e.g. raga performance time, vadi/samvadi) may support raga candidate filtering (can_influence_raga_recommendation=true) because it is not a clinical claim -- but must never be relabeled as evidence-based.
